posts.title: Benjamin Beilman Returning to New Century
posts.description: Benjamin Beilman with his violin (from the NCCO Web page for upcoming concerts) Violinist Benjamin Beilman first performed with the New Century Chamber Orchestra (NCCO) in November of 2017. posts.title: Angel Blue to Make SFP Debut Next Month
posts.description: Soprano Angel Blue, from the Web page for purchasing tickets to her recital. Soprano Angel Blue is no stranger to San Francisco. Sadly, encounters with her performances are few and far between. The last time I saw her on the stage in this city was a little over six years ago, when she made her Orchestra Series debut with the San Francisco Symphony as the soprano soloist for a performance of Ludwig
